name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: Miners who hone their craft can shape lodestones to enhance their wilderness campsites, offering martial benefits to allies resting beside them.
Camps rely fundamentally on a well-tended campfire, making basic culinary training an essential partner to specialized camp accessories.
Gelman Stonehand operates out of Stormwind City, guiding Alliance tradesfolk in turning raw earthcraft into practical field utilities.

faq.answer: This quest introduces miners to the art of crafting specialized campsite enhancements. Once you prove your proficiency in mining, you speak with Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to learn how to forge a lodestone.
Gelman Stonehand is a mining trainer situated within Stormwind City. He teaches qualified miners how to craft a lodestone to bolster their expeditions in the wild.

A lodestone is an item set down at a wilderness campsite. It emits an empowering presence around the campfire that enhances the combat prowess of warriors and other martial fighters who gather to rest there.

City authorities and common folk do not appreciate camps pitched in town squares or along city streets. You must journey out into the wilderness beyond settlement gates to set up camp and deploy your lodestone.
faq.q: Can I set up camp inside Stormwind?

aliases: do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: Every campsite requires a basic campfire as its core foundation before any specialized camp equipment can be used. Cooks commonly teach travelers how to start fires with simple wood and flint.
faq.q: Why do I need a campfire to set up camp?

faq.answer: Anyone who swings a blade, axe, or hammer benefits greatly from the lodestone's power. It radiates an extra martial edge that fighters seek out while resting by the flames before a dangerous battle.
faq.q: Who benefits most from gathering around a Lodestone?

sections.body: Mining is tough, honest labor, but its rewards go far beyond smelting raw ingots and shaping armor. Dedicated miners in Stormwind can learn to harness the natural magnetism of the earth into a functional lodestone. When placed at an expedition's campsite, this stone bolsters the combat vigor of any fighter gathered around the hearth fire. Gelman Stonehand, the seasoned mining instructor in the kingdom's capital, passes down the craft to prospectors who demonstrate proficiency with a pickaxe.
sections.title: The Earth's Resonant Power

sections.body: A lodestone cannot simply be dropped onto the cobblestones of Cathedral Square or the Trade District. Townsfolk take a dim view of travelers pitching temporary encampments within city limits, meaning pioneers must head out into the untamed wilds to establish camp. Furthermore, specialized gear like a lodestone is useless without the warm foundation of a campfire, a fundamental wilderness survival skill taught by cooks across the realm.
sections.title: Wilderness Camps and Campfires

summary: Camping 101: Mining is an introductory quest that teaches miners how to craft a lodestone to enhance wilderness campsites. Instructed by Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind, prospectors learn to channel resonant earthcraft to bolster their companions' combat prowess around the campfire.
